_comment: Quillmere Pen Co. 'Meridian 14 fountain pen (tidewater teal)' — the worked example. Copy to config.json and edit. A ~15s premium 3D product showcase: one real product floats centered on a clean seamless brand-color backdrop and sells itself across 4 beats — Beat 1 an orbiting hero rotation, Beat 2 a macro push-in on the surface detail, Beat 3 a physics reveal (reveal_variant), then Beat 4 a typographic brand close. 720x1280 9:16, music-only (no VO). IDENTITY: Beats 1+2 are create-video-fal image-to-video seeded on a create-image-fal STYLED HERO built from the brand's real product photo (real geometry, never AI-invented). Beat 3 is Veo3 i2v seeded on Beat 1's last frame. Beat 4 is a deterministic Playwright hyperframe. One ElevenLabs instrumental bed, loudnorm I=-16. There is NO Higgsfield / Marketing Studio in this format. Creative fields — studio_look.bg, studio_look.lighting_preset, studio_look.rim_light, the <BG>/<LIGHTING> phrases inside beats[].prompt, product_identity.step_1, reveal_variant, beats[2], music.prompt — come from the recipe's choices (backdrop, lighting_mood, reveal, music); never copy them as defaults. Deep teal + luxe_botanical_warm are this demo's picks, not the format's look.

product._note: the REAL product — its geometry is locked by the create-image-fal styled hero built from the real product photo; never AI-invented
product.name: Meridian 14 fountain pen (tidewater teal)
product.form_factor: four-part fountain pen: screw cap with brass band, steel nib section, piston ink converter, teal resin barrel

_reveal_variant_note: pick by category: cosmetic bottle/liquid or fragrance -> particle_disintegration; beverage OR a water product (spa/tub/fountain) -> liquid_splash; multi-part / structural product -> exploded_view; large/featureless no-reveal product (a tool, a solid appliance) -> rotation_only (skip Beat 3). The Meridian 14 is a four-part pen -> exploded_view.

studio_look._bg_note: deep teal (the demo brand primary) — the seamless backdrop AND the normalize pad color
studio_look._lighting_note: the lighting_mood choice. luxe_botanical_warm (warm rim upper-right, soft fill below, warm bokeh) is the demo's pick; others: clean_bright_daylight, dramatic_hard_key, cool_tech_rim — describe the chosen mood in rim_light and in every beat prompt
studio_look.rim_light: strong warm rim light from upper-right; soft fill from below
studio_look.register: premium product film — glossy speculars, warm bokeh, clean seamless backdrop, no people, no hands, no on-screen text on the plate

product_identity._note: identity lock — the analog of a character lock. Run BEFORE any i2v clip call. NO Marketing Studio.
product_identity.step_1: create-image-fal (fal-ai/nano-banana/edit) — restyle the real product photo onto the seamless brand-color set (centered ~50-55% frame height, warm rim light upper-right, warm bokeh, 9:16, geometry IDENTICAL to the reference, no people/hands/text) -> hero_styled.png
product_identity.step_2: host hero_styled.png via MCP file_url (mode upload, PUT, then mode download) so create-video-fal can seed the beats off a PUBLIC url
product_identity.hard_rule: the product geometry ALWAYS comes from the real product photo via the create-image-fal restyle — never a text-only AI invention. A lifestyle photo works too; the restyle isolates the product onto the studio set.

beats.label: Hero rotation — orbiting camera
beats._model_note: create-video-fal i2v seeded on hero_styled.png. Seedance Lite is the cheap default; swap to seedance/v1/pro or kling-video/v3/pro/image-to-video for higher fidelity. All are charged to your GooseWorks credits through the GooseWorks proxy.
beats._duration_note: i2v takes are ~5s; build_masters trims to 4s. A single i2v yields a partial arc (~60-120°), NOT a literal 360 — do not promise a full turn.
beats.motion: A slow deliberate camera orbit around the product; product stays centered horizontally, occupying ~50% of frame height.
beats.prompt: 9:16 PRODUCT-SHOWCASE HERO ROTATION. The Quillmere Meridian 14 — a glossy teal resin fountain pen with a brass cap band and a polished steel nib. A slow deliberate camera orbit around the pen. Pen stays centered horizontally, occupying ~50% of frame height, geometry solid and unchanged. Deep teal seamless backdrop. Strong warm rim light from upper-right; soft fill from below. Subtle warm bokeh in background. Engraved 'quillmere' wordmark on the cap band visible during the orbit. Cinematic, premium craft-object product film. Product identical to the seed hero. No on-screen text.
beats.produces_anchor: beat1_last_frame.png (ffmpeg -sseof -0.1 -i beat1.mp4 -frames:v 1) — the SHARED seed for Beat 3 AND the Beat 4 hyperframe background

beats.label: Macro detail — push-in on the nib
beats._start_image_note: SAME styled hero as Beat 1 so the product reads identical across both beats
beats.motion: Camera moves smoothly along the barrel to the nib, revealing the engraved scrollwork and the ink slit, with metal detail catching warm rim light; shallow DOF.
beats.prompt: 9:16 MACRO PUSH-IN along the length of the Quillmere Meridian 14 fountain pen. Camera moves smoothly along the barrel to the nib, revealing the engraved scrollwork and the ink slit on the polished steel nib, with metal detail catching warm rim light. Shallow depth of field. Strong specular highlights on the glossy teal resin barrel. Warm bokeh background. Engraved 'quillmere' wordmark visible. Product identical to the seed hero. No on-screen text.

beats.label: Reveal — exploded_view
beats._duration_note: Veo3 fast i2v defaults to an 8s take (no 4s option on the fal-proxy); build_masters trims the best 4s window (rise -> peak -> early settle). Priciest single call in the format.
beats._reveal_spatial_rule: the reveal prompt MUST name WHERE the reveal happens (which surface faces the gap) — without it Veo3 tends to pop a part off at random and smear the surface instead of a clean, readable separation. The prompt below shows the spatial clause.
beats.prompt: The Quillmere Meridian 14 fountain pen separates smoothly along its long horizontal axis into four parts — cap, nib section, ink converter, barrel — sliding apart with even gaps between them. At each gap the threaded joints face each other, brass threads on the left part, resin threads on the right part (like an engineering diagram). A few tiny ink droplets drift through the centre gap. The parts smoothly reassemble. Deep teal seamless backdrop. Camera holds steady, pen stays centered. No on-screen text. No text whatsoever.

beats.label: Brand close — typographic end card
beats.headline: FOUR PARTS · ONE PEN
beats._headline_size_note: shrunk from the 110 default because the middot string needs to fit one line at 88% safe area

headline._color_note: warm-white (#F6F1E7) on dark/saturated bg, dark ink (#2A1F26) on light/pastel bg. The demo's deep-teal bg is dark -> #F6F1E7. build_endcard.py --headline-color to override.

wordmark._note: the REAL brand wordmark — never retyped, never AI-rendered. build_endcard.py recolors the SVG to the headline color.

end_card.render_dims: 1080x1920 then ffmpeg scale -> 720x1280 (matching the viewport to the output clips the right edge)

music.prompt: Minimal ambient-electronic instrumental, soft felt piano over warm analog pads, slow build for 6 seconds, gentle kick + sub-bass drop at 7s carrying through to end. 100 BPM. Premium craft-object film aesthetic. No vocals, atmospheric only.

audio_mix.music_bus: afade in 0.3s + afade out 0.6s (near the end) + loudnorm I=-16 TP=-1.5 LRA=11, apad + atrim to master duration
audio_mix.master_bus: loudnorm I=-16 (IG/TikTok safe), -1.5 dBTP true peak

captions._note: N/A — music-only, no VO; the only on-screen text is the Beat 4 hyperframe headline (deterministic, not a burned caption)

finalize.normalize: per beat: trim to window, scale=720:1280:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=720:1280:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=<bg>,setsar=1 + 24fps + yuv420p + -an (strip the i2v model auto-audio) + crf 18
finalize.concat: ffmpeg concat demuxer over the normalized segments
